title: CHOP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Channel operators, covering channel counts, sample counts, sample rate, time-slice state, channel lookup, NumPy conversion, keyframe conversion, and channel export.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to inspect CHOP channels, sample counts, time ranges, or convert channel data to arrays or keyframes.
Set rate and start/startTime before len/end/endTime when modifying Script CHOP channel ranges because the attributes depend on each other.
Use chan() for the first matching channel or None, and chans() for a list of matches or all channels.
Use numChans, numSamples, and rate for channel-shape validation instead of assuming audio or control-rate defaults.
Use numpyArray() for bulk numeric reads and save() for .clip, .bclip, .chan, .bchan, or .aiff export.
